Command: Do not carry Passover flesh outside the house
Summary: The flesh of the Passover lamb must be eaten in the one house where the meal is kept, not carried outside.
Commandment: Do not carry any of the Passover flesh out of the house; eat it in the one house.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. The rule kept the household meal whole on the night of deliverance. The New Testament reads the Passover lamb as fulfilled in Christ, our Passover sacrificed for us (1 Corinthians 5:7).
Purpose: Scripture's stated context: the meal is eaten in haste on the night of deliverance from Egypt, ready to depart (Exodus 12:11).
